summary: Iteration 9 verified stale-data mitigations: (a) Cache-Control no-store + Pragma no-cache on /api/settings, /api/vouchers, /api/stats, /api/auth/me, /api/reports/daily; (b) DELETE /api/vouchers/{id} and POST /api/vouchers/bulk-delete cascade-delete redemption_logs so /api/stats today_redeemed, recent_redemptions and /api/reports/daily counts decrease consistently; (c) useAutoRefresh hook re-fetches on window focus + visibilitychange and on ~30s interval on VoucherManagement and AdminDashboard. Two-context Playwright test: ctx1 on /admin/vouchers, ctx2 creates + deletes voucher via API; after dispatching visibilitychange+focus on ctx1 (no reload), new voucher FE9X appears and deleted code disappears. Same pattern verified on /admin dashboard after ctx2 redemption. Idle 33s produced >=1 automatic GET /api/vouchers.
critical_code_review_comments: useAutoRefresh interval fires every 30s unconditionally regardless of tab visibility. It does call onVisible which checks document.visibilityState, so hidden tabs skip the refetch (good). Consider clearing/pausing the interval when tab is hidden to save mobile battery.
no_cache_api middleware sets Cache-Control on every /api response including auth/login; correct for freshness but means service workers / CDNs cannot cache any API. Acceptable for this app.
delete_voucher & bulk_delete_vouchers do not verify tenancy (any admin can delete any voucher) but this is a single-admin app.

reports/daily $dateToString uses UTC date without timezone -> Indonesian day boundary may bucket late-evening WIB redemptions into the next UTC day. Consider passing timezone: 'Asia/Jakarta' to $dateToString (MongoDB 5+).
stats today_redeemed uses UTC midnight not WIB midnight; same TZ drift concern as reports.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create vouchers with prefixes IT9A/IT9B/IT9C, redeem, then delete. FE test creates prefixes FE9X (delete-appear/disappear) and FE9R (redemption) and cleans up via ctx2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration9.py covers no-cache headers on 5 endpoints + delete-cascade for single/bulk. FE two-context test lives inline (browser.new_context via page.context.browser). Response fields: /api/stats uses today_redeemed (not today_redemptions) and recent_redemptions (not recent). Voucher create requires title + expires_at (ISO string), not quantity+expires_in_days.
